source_preservation_check: Inherited candidate URL and version identities unchanged in each reviser map; no source count used as grade.

observed_source_operations.local_inputs: Read exact mapped original brief/plan/rubric, all 30 candidate files and mapped source-root notes; SHA-256/byte identity checks and source-ID URL/version preservation checks. No runtime fixture execution.
observed_source_operations.public_primary: web open/find of public primary documentation/GitHub pages; independent bounded HTTPS retrievals of documentation, tagged source, metadata and PR diffs. No download was executed.
observed_source_operations.api_failures: H07–H15 returned 403 rate-limit errors; corresponding needed issue/PR/release conclusions checked via J/K HTML/raw/diff fallbacks. Initial web API release open returned Internal Error; HTML release datetime succeeded. Some web find calls returned Internal Error or no matches; those were not counted as affirmative evidence.
observed_source_operations.writes: assessment.md, assessment.json, source-map.json and four bounded evidence JSON files only under exact output root.
observed_source_operations.incidental_startup_access: Broad rg filename enumeration returned other-experiment path names; no contents of those cases or evaluations opened or used. Repository-mandated Plans index read, not used as scientific standard.

scope_and_drift_limits: Complete six-axis original-brief assessment, not unlimited production assurance or whole-library source audit
Minor unconfirmed Arrow example locator isolated; its meaningful capability verified
Source documents mutable where stated; future binary/release qualification and real product datasets/performance not executed
Incidental startup filenames and repository-required index read disclosed; no other evaluation/other-case content used
Original N1 pre-reveal discovery text not in exact map; independence cannot be certified
lifecycle_authority: Supported create/get/update Goal tool history; no synthesized Goal receipt; reviewer active while this science is written.
